title: Shi-part minimum representatives form a Garside shadow in finitely generated Coxeter groups
author: Przytyck, Piotr; Yau, Yeeka
difficulty_reason: The author replaces local maxima of Shi-component paths inside finite dihedral residues, proves termination by a lexicographic length-complexity measure, and establishes monotonicity of the minimum map by bipodal wall separation. These new geometric steps prove join and suffix closure of the full minimum set, beyond a Garside definition check.
